title: Making a Guest Feel at Home
context: Tara 的朋友 Alex 首次来她家过夜；她介绍房间并安排早餐。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，题目是原创口语练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Tara
dialogue.en: Welcome, Alex! Come in and put your bag down.
dialogue.zh: 欢迎你，Alex！进来把包放下吧。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Thanks, Tara. It's good to see you after such a long trip.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，Tara。走了这么远的路，见到你真好。

dialogue.speaker: Tara
dialogue.en: You must be tired. Would you like some water first?
dialogue.zh: 你一定累了。要先喝点水吗？

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Yes, please. Then could you show me where I can leave my bag?
dialogue.zh: 好，谢谢。然后能告诉我把包放在哪里吗？

dialogue.speaker: Tara
dialogue.en: Your room is at the end of the hall, next to the bathroom.
dialogue.zh: 你的房间在走廊尽头，浴室旁边。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: That's easy to find. Is there a towel I can use?
dialogue.zh: 很容易找到。有我可以用的毛巾吗？

dialogue.speaker: Tara
dialogue.en: I've put a clean one on the bed, along with an extra blanket.
dialogue.zh: 我在床上放了一条干净的毛巾，还有一条备用毯子。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Perfect. What time do you usually have breakfast?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。你通常几点吃早餐？

dialogue.speaker: Tara
dialogue.en: Around eight, but there's no need to get up early for me.
dialogue.zh: 大约八点，不过你不用为了我早起。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: I might sleep a little longer, if that's all right.
dialogue.zh: 如果可以的话，我可能会多睡一会儿。

dialogue.speaker: Tara
dialogue.en: Of course. Help yourself to breakfast whenever you're ready.
dialogue.zh: 当然。你准备好后随时自己拿早餐吃。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Thank you. I'll settle in and join you in a little while.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我先安顿一下，过一会儿来找你。

expressions.example: Put your bag down beside the chair.
The elevator is at the end of the hall.
I packed a hat along with my coat.
It took me a day to settle in.

pronunciation: towel 通常有两个音节，重音在第一音节；在 help yourself 中注意 help 末尾的 /p/。

practice.title: Part 1 · Guests
practice.prompt: Do you like having guests stay at your home?
practice.answer: Yes, when I have enough space. I enjoy talking over breakfast and showing them around my neighborhood.

practice.title: Part 2 · A visit
practice.prompt: Describe a time you visited someone and felt welcome. Say who you visited, what they did, and how you felt.
practice.answer: I once stayed with a friend in another city for a weekend. When I arrived, she offered me water and showed me the room where I could sleep. She had put a clean towel on the bed and told me I could have breakfast whenever I was ready. Her small acts of kindness helped me relax after my journey. I felt comfortable asking questions. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Hospitality
practice.prompt: Why do small acts of hospitality matter to visitors?
practice.answer: Visitors may feel tired or uncertain in an unfamiliar place. Clear information and a warm welcome can help them relax and feel included.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读后欢迎一位留宿朋友，说明房间、毛巾和早餐安排。
practice.answer: Welcome! Your room is next to the bathroom. There's a clean towel on the bed. Help yourself to breakfast in the morning.
